meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能接入 GitHub：它会以你指定的机器人账号身份，在 pull request 和 issue 的评论里被 @ 时回复，并继续参与后续讨论。
howto.when: 当有人在已接入仓库的 PR 或 issue 评论中 @ 机器人账号时触发；首次 @ 后该评论线程被订阅，之后所有后续评论都会触发回复。

say.text: 帮我接入 GitHub 仓库 acme/backend 的评论线程。
say.note: 会配置适配器并连接该仓库。

say.text: 配置一个机器人账号，用于回复 GitHub 的 PR 和 issue。
say.note: 需要提供令牌和用户名等信息。

say.text: 把 GitHub 通道设为严格模式，只让指定成员触发。
say.note: 会引导你添加信任的用户。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can integrate with GitHub: it replies as the designated bot account when @-mentioned in pull request and issue comments, and continues participating in the thread afterwards.
howto.when_en: Triggered when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment on a connected repository; after the first mention, the thread is subscribed and all subsequent comments trigger a reply.

say_en.text: Connect the GitHub repo acme/backend comment threads for me.
say_en.note: It will configure the adapter and link the repo.

say_en.text: Set up a bot account to reply to GitHub PRs and issues.
say_en.note: You'll need to provide token and username.

say_en.text: Set the GitHub channel to strict mode, only letting specified members trigger.
say_en.note: It will guide you to add trusted users.
